output.name: evalify
output.purpose: Design and execute calibrated evaluations of nondeterministic behavior using established frameworks.

criteria.description: Define the actual workload and observable success, including deterministic gates.
Calibrate any model judge against independently labeled examples and record limitations.
Retain matched runs, elapsed time, costs, failures and confirmation evidence.

limits: A recorded review does not authenticate judge calibration, model behavior, or semantic quality.
Promptfoo must be separately installed; native execution can call providers and execute configuration code.
The helper deadline does not prove remote cancellation or cleanup of detached descendants.
